rules.why: vanilla peers carry a per-area thickness; the GoH port carries its plates per volume (volume/thickness/*, kept by armor-01). An area thickness of 0 is the reader's default and means the volume's own plate is used, so the key is added with no change to any armour number
rules.src: reader  (one number = every side); 0 = volume's own:  (area != 0.0f replaces own) and  (default 0, comment '0 for theirs'); key presence vanilla 60 of 60 tank_medium, 67 of 69 cannon, 29 of 30 btr
